title: Efficiency per task is not fleet energy
caption: Fleet energy index relative to the baseline, computed from the chapter's fleet identity. Inelastic demand preserves a 4x efficiency gain as a 4x reduction; the same gain with twentyfold volume growth produces a fivefold increase, and a halved query cost with 3.5x volume nets 1.75x. Efficiency creates room inside a resource budget; demand decides how much of the room is consumed.

title: Serving overtakes training in months
caption: The chapter's crossover arithmetic: a one-time 1,200 MWh training run against a service answering 8 million requests per day at 0.0005 kWh each, which is 4 MWh of serving energy per day. Cumulative inference energy reaches the entire training outlay around day 300 and passes it within the first year. The crossover is workload-specific: query volume, per-query energy and grid intensity all move it.
